description.value: A full-service hotel and convention centre operated by the Coast Hotels chain, located on Fraser Highway in Langley, BC. It is part of a large regional network stretching across western Canada and offers meeting and event facilities alongside standard hotel accommodations. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor would find it a substantial, well-resourced stopover, though bike-specific services are unconfirmed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The fetched website is the corporate Coast Hotels homepage (coasthotels.com), which contains no property-level amenity details for the Langley location — only navigation menus and membership rate tables. The rewards/directory subpage lists the Langley property as 'Coast Langley City Hotel & Convention Centre,' which differs from the OSM name 'Coast Hotel and Convention Centre.' OSM tags confirm free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) and wheelchair accessibility, but provide no cycling-specific amenity data, leaving all bike-related criteria unverifiable.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Coast Hotel and Convention Centre' but the Coast Hotels rewards/directory page lists the Langley property as 'Coast Langley City Hotel & Convention Centre'.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate operating hotel in Langley on a cycling corridor, but neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from the available corporate website content. Direct contact with the property or a dedicated property page is needed before inclusion.
